chunks: From him, from al-Hasan, from al-'Ala', from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:
I said to Abu 'Abdillah عليه السلام: Until when does the pilgrim have 'umrah? He said: Until dawn-time in the night of 'Arafah.

key_terms.عُمْرَةٌ: the ritual lesser pilgrimage, here referring to the 'umrah connected to tamattu'
key_terms.لَيْلَةِ عَرَفَةَ: the night preceding the day of 'Arafah

ai.seo_question: Until when can a pilgrim perform the 'umrah of tamattu' before 'Arafah?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about the latest time at which the pilgrim may still perform the 'umrah of tamattu'. Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام states that its time extends until the pre-dawn time of the night of 'Arafah.
